facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.definition_citation: "Delinquency Ratio" means, for any Collection Period, the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of (a) the aggregate Outstanding Pool Balance of all Delinquent Receivables as of the last day of such Collection Period to (b) the aggregate Outstanding Pool Balance of all Receivables in the Reference Pool as of the last day of such Collection Period.
facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.definition_text: The Delinquency Ratio is calculated as the aggregate Outstanding Pool Balance of all Delinquent Receivables (those with a scheduled payment unpaid for 60 days or more) as of the last day of a Collection Period, divided by the aggregate Outstanding Pool Balance of all Receivables in the Reference Pool as of the last day of such Collection Period. A Delinquency Trigger occurs if this ratio exceeds 5.00%.
facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.extraction_notes: The operative covenant is stated in Section 5.01 (Borrower shall not permit a Delinquency Trigger to occur and be continuing), which incorporates the Delinquency Trigger definition (Delinquency Ratio exceeding 5.00%) from Article I. Breach becomes an Event of Default if uncured for 30 days per Section 7.01(c), and may be cured under Section 5.03.

threshold_tiers.citation: "Delinquency Trigger" means, with respect to any Collection Period, the event that occurs if the Delinquency Ratio for such Collection Period, as reported pursuant to Section 6.01, exceeds 5.00%.

facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.definition_citation: "Overcollateralization Test" means the test that is satisfied on any Determination Date if the Overcollateralization Amount as of such Determination Date is greater than or equal to the Overcollateralization Target Amount as of such Determination Date.
facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.definition_text: The Overcollateralization Amount is the excess, if any, of (a) the Outstanding Pool Balance of Eligible Receivables in the Reference Pool as of a Determination Date over (b) the Note Balance as of such Determination Date. The Overcollateralization Target Amount is 8.00% of the Outstanding Pool Balance of Eligible Receivables in the Reference Pool as of such Determination Date. The Overcollateralization Test is satisfied if the Overcollateralization Amount is greater than or equal to the Overcollateralization Target Amount.
facility_a_credit_agreement.txt.extraction_notes: The operative covenant is in Section 5.02 (Borrower shall ensure the Overcollateralization Test is satisfied as of each Determination Date). Failure for two consecutive Determination Dates, if uncured within 30 days per Section 7.01(c), constitutes an Event of Default. Cure available under Section 5.03.

facility_c_credit_agreement.txt.definition_citation: "Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio" means, as of the last day of any Test Period, the ratio of (a) Consolidated Net Debt as of such date to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period then ended.
facility_c_credit_agreement.txt.definition_text: Ratio of Consolidated Net Debt (aggregate outstanding principal amount of Indebtedness for borrowed money minus unrestricted cash and cash equivalents) to Consolidated EBITDA (Consolidated Net Income plus interest expense, taxes, depreciation and amortization, non-cash stock-based compensation, and certain approved non-recurring/extraordinary items) for the relevant Test Period.
facility_c_credit_agreement.txt.extraction_notes: Covenant includes an equity cure right (Section 6.02) allowing cash contributions to be added to Consolidated EBITDA for purposes of calculating this ratio, exercisable no more than twice during the term of the Agreement.
